subject: POC onboarding & weekly check-ins for AvaSolutions evaluation
messages_1_subject: POC onboarding & weekly check-ins for AvaSolutions evaluation
messages_1_body:
Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the productive discovery call this morning — great context on your primary evaluation goals. Per our discussion, I put together a short POC playbook and a suggested cadence so we can move quickly toward a final readout. I attached the one-pager (redwood_poc_playbook_v1.pdf) and included the core success criteria below.

Proposed high-level success criteria: 
- Quality: match or exceed current baseline for customer-facing responses on the 5 sample prompts in your sheet (F1 >= 0.78 on our eval harness)
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 450ms for 256-token outputs in our staging environment
- Cost: per-1000-token cost <= your target threshold (we noted $15/1k in the call)
- Integration: end-to-end embedding + rerank flow working with your sample dataset (no PII in samples)

Suggested timeline and milestones: 
- Kickoff (remote): Tue, Mar 30 2026, 11:00 AM PT — technical intro, environment signoff, data handoff owner
- Week 1: baseline runs + model recommendation; environment and auth verified
- Week 2: integration of embeddings + reranking; latency tuning and batching experiments
- Week 3: stability runs, regression checks, initial readout draft
- Final readout: Thu, Apr 23 2026 — demo + go/no-go decision

Ownership (proposed):
- Redwood: vanessa_ortiz (POC lead), dylan_brooks (SRE/infra lead), aditya_rao (security/SSO & KMS lead)
- AvaSolutions: Emma Fisher (POC sponsor), Carlos Ruiz (engineering lead)

Next steps: 
1) Confirm kickoff date/time (I propose Mar 30, 11:00 AM PT)
2) Please attach the sample dataset or a redacted subset (we prefer S3 link or Drive)
3) Confirm VP or final stakeholder for the Apr 23 readout if you'd like them looped in early

Attachments: redwood_poc_playbook_v1.pdf (attached)

Calendar invite + shared Drive link to follow once kickoff is confirmed.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

---
This email and attachments contain confidential information intended for the above recipients. If you received this in error, please notify the sender and delete the message.
messages_2_subject: Re: POC onboarding & weekly check-ins for AvaSolutions evaluation
messages_2_body:
Thanks Vanessa — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Latency target: we can be flexible, but the product team really wants 95p <= 400ms if possible. Can you flag whether that’s realistic for our expected 256-token bursts?
2) Data: I attached a redacted sample (ava_requirements_sheet.xlsx) — it contains ~3k rows; let us know if you need smaller subsets or a sanitized S3 link.
3) Stakeholders: our VP of Product (Maya Singh) would like to attend the final readout on Apr 23. She’s not required for weekly tech check-ins.

Confirm kickoff on Mar 30 at 11:00 AM PT works for us. Please include a calendar invite and dial-in.

A couple of asks for your infra/security folks: 
- We require a short note on data retention during the POC (how long logs/input are stored and who has access)
- Any KMS/HSM flow for encryption of customer keys — high level is fine ahead of kickoff

Appreciate the quick turnaround, looking forward to the kickoff.

—Emma
Emma Fisher
Director of Platform Engineering | AvaSolutions
emma.fisher@avasolutions.com

Attachments: ava_requirements_sheet.xlsx
messages_3_subject: Internal: AvaSolutions POC - ownership & infra prep
messages_3_body:
Team — forwarding Emma’s confirmation and sample file. Kickoff locked for Tue Mar 30, 11:00 AM PT. I need the following items finalized before the call: 

Dylan: please provision a staging tenant for AvaSolutions with the recommended model variants (start with a q4_8bit candidate and a full fp16 for comparison). Document the expected 95p latency for 256-token generation and any recommended batch sizing. Prep a short demo that shows embedding + rerank flow end-to-end.

Aditya: Emma requested a short note on data retention and a KMS/HSM flow. Can you draft a one-page bullet doc that covers: 
- retention window for POC logs/requests (recommended default 30 days, configurable)
- who has access internally and how we mask PII in telemetry
- high-level KMS flow (customer-managed key supported? we will describe envelope encryption)

Marissa: I’ll need you to confirm the commercial guardrails (trial credits, any promotional pricing) so I can give Emma a clear expectation during kickoff.

Delivery timeline for the internal prep items: EOD Mon Mar 29. I’m copying the external invite holders once we have the calendar invite. 

Quoted from Emma’s note: 
> "Latency target: we can be flexible, but the product team really wants 95p <= 400ms if possible."

Let’s be pragmatic — surface any hard blockers ASAP. If we can meet 400ms in staging with modest quantization and batching changes, call it out. If not, propose a latency tradeoff matrix we can show in kickoff.

Thanks,
Vanessa

(Attachment: none)
